title: Why mosquitoes pick you and ignore your friend
chunks: to fatty acids on the skin.

beats.pick: the mosquito dives at Mia, who is already covered in bites and steaming red
beats.ignore: it flies past Otto, who sips lemonade, smug
beats.hundred: a swarm of dots around the volunteer grows against one dot at the other
beats.fatty: skin cross-section: orange droplets of acid appear on the skin layer
beats.bacteria: green bacteria eat the droplets and puff purple smell upward
beats.personal: the purple smell drifts to a flat mosquito that sniffs it
beats.three: three differently coloured mosquitoes arrive in the lab
beats.nineteen: a crowd of volunteers pops into rows
beats.nobody: a volunteer sits calm while two mosquitoes land and a third turns away, red X pops
beats.different: three people, three scent clouds, three mosquitoes each flying to their own
beats.tonight: a new yellow mosquito flies past Mia and lands on Otto's lemonade; Otto freezes
